profile.headline: Software Engineer II | MSCS @ ASU | 3+ Years of Building Scalable Software | U.S. Permanent Resident
profile.summary:
👨‍💻 Software Engineer II | 4+ Years of Software Engineering experience | U.S. Permanent Resident 

I am currently working as a Software Engineer II at Valens Software with a master’s degree in computer science from Arizona State University in August 2025. With a strong 3 years of work experience as software engineer, I specialize in building scalable applications, optimizing performance, and driving impactful user experiences. I have hands-on experience working with modern frameworks, cloud technologies, and developing solutions that enhance business operations and user engagement. I have a strong foundation in algorithms, data structures, databases, and system design.

🌐 Relevant Skills:

Programming Languages: Java, Python, PHP, C++, C, 
Frontend: HTML, CSS, Javascript, React, Redux, Next.js, Tailwind, Bootstrap, Chakra UI, Material UI, D3.js, Chart.js
Backend: Node.js, Express.js, Django, Flask, Spring Boot, GraphQL
Databases: MySQL, SQL Server, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, NoSQL 
DevOps: AWS, GCP, Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Gitlab, Bash, Powershell, Terraform, CloudFormation                                                                                                        
Developer Tools: Git, Github, Postman, Figma, Visual Studio Code, Eclipse, JIRA, Apache, Selenium, Junit, IntelliJ
Soft Skills:  Teamwork, Leadership, Communication, Flexibility, Problem-solving, Critical thinking, Decision Making

🚀 Key Projects:

Stock Portfolio Management: Built a real-time portfolio management web app using React, Node.js, and MongoDB, allowing users to track stock performance and profits.

Chat Application: Developed a real-time messaging platform with React, Node.js, and Socket.IO, providing both global and private chat functionalities.

💡 What Drives Me:

Crafting high-quality software that improves the user experience and drives business success.
Continuously learning and applying new technologies to build efficient, scalable systems.
Collaborating with innovative teams to solve complex challenges and deliver results.

Let’s Connect!
I’m always eager to network with like-minded professionals and explore new opportunities. Feel free to reach out for:

🌟 Career opportunities
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Collaborations
💬 Tech discussions or insights

📍 Location: Atlanta, USA
📧 Contact: meetp.careers@gmail.com
📱 Phone: (470)-871-8810
